description: mixed content types — tests layout variety selection
goal: Create a 6-slide all-hands meeting deck for a 200-person company. Slide 1: Title — 'AllHands — June 2026'. Slide 2: Numbers that matter — ARR $24M (+32% YoY), headcount 212 (+40), customer count 890 (+120), NPS 68 (displayed as big metrics). Slide 3: Two-column layout — Left: 'What we shipped in H1' (5 bullet points of features), Right: 'What customers say about it' (3 short testimonial quotes). Slide 4: Organization update — new VP of Engineering (Sarah Chen, from Google), new Chief of Staff (Marcus Williams, from Stripe). Slide 5: H2 priorities — 3 big themes each with an image concept and 2 bullets. Slide 6: Thank you + open Q&A.
stress: layout variety, metrics + quotes + images in same deck
